title: Export to Core Events
description: Choose the event, then the days
noDay: {event} has no scoring row for these items.
daysHint: Only the days whose scoring rows count an item are listed. Hall of Chief lists stages instead of days. Each group of items gets its own day.
lineNotScored: {event} has no scoring row for this.
nothingScores: Nothing in this plan scores in {event} on the chosen days.
summaryHint: What the same items would score in each event when every item is spent on a day that scores it. Only the selected event and days receive them. The Core Events page shows them as counts you can change.
